### Why the Economy?

I have forever thought most issues derive from people feeling there is a gap in reaching their basic necessities and that this is an increasing issue now. I wanted to explore how numbers can quantify this with public government data while also recognnizing a lot of media messaging now is speaking to the contrary, that the U.S has never been better economically. This naturally led to the idea of the k-shapped economy and most interestingly how both these ideas can be true. This is my attempt to explore a piece of this topic that I find very interesting.


This project formatting was inspired by this bigfoot scrollytelling article seen <a href= "https://edenian-prince.github.io/bigfoot-closeread/">here</a>

Data source, scraping, and processing details can be found here in [My GitHub repo](https://github.com/Germjuar/K-Shapped-Final)
